title: 21 in. Recycler SmartStow 60-Volt Lithium-Ion Brushless Cordless Battery Walk Behind Mower RWD 5.0 Ah w/ Battery&amp;Charger
description:
This isn’t just any walk-behind mower. The Super Recycler is what other mowers aspire to be. Leveraging time-tested Toro engineering, the Super Recycler delivers the perfect cut every time, while nourishing your lawn to provide a rich, green cut that landscape pros relish. Fertilize your lawn while you mow with Toro’s Super Recycler Cutting System…
Durable Steel Deck – Enjoy years of reliable use from your deck thanks to its steel construction.
Ready To Work – The 60 Volt battery has intelligent battery software to maximize run time and power.
Extended Life – Enjoy less friction, lower maintenance and less wear on your engine with a high-performance brushless DC motor.
Power Without Compromise – Cuts up to 1/3 of acre in 40 minutes or less on a full charge. (Based on L324 battery – sold separately.)
Feed Your Lawn – The ultra-fine clippings created by our Recycler Cutting System are Lawn Vitamins™, nourishing your grass.
Use any 60V Max* Flex-Force battery to power any and all of the 75+ tools in the all-season lineup
Download the MyToro app from your mobile device’s app store for easy access to product resources, including manuals, how-to’s, and more
